ड: ड 1. ड, the third letter of the cerebral class of consonants, having much the sound of द् in drum, but properly pronounced by keeping back the tip of the tongue and slightly turning it upwards. In Bengal ड् is often confounded in pronunciation with a hard र्. —ड-कार, अस्, m. the letter or sound ड्।
ड 2. ड, अस्, m. a sound; a kind of drum or tabor; fear; submarine fire; an epithet of Śiva; (आ), f. a Ḍākinī, i. e. a kind of female imp or goblin; a basket &c. carried by means of a sling.
डक्कारी: डक्कारी डक्कारी, f. the lute of the Cāṇḍālas.
डङ्गर: डङ्गर डङ्गर, अस्, m. = डिङ्गर, throwing, casting; (ई), f. a kind of gourd; (also डङ्गारी, &c.)
डप्: डप् डप्, cl. 10. A. डापयते, &c., to col-lect, accumulate, heap together.
डम्: डम् डम्, cl. 1. P. डमति, &c., to sound.
डम: डम डम, अस्, m. a despised mixed caste (commonly Ḍom), the son of a Cāṇḍālī and a Leṭa, employed to clear away filth &c.
डमर: डमर डमर, अस्, आ, m. f. a riot, tumult, affray, a conflict without weapons; terrifying an enemy by shouts and gestures; petty or predatory warfare carried on by detachments or between villages and not kings; (अम्), n. flight, rout, running away through fear; [cf. डामर।]
डमरिन्: डमरिन् डमरिन्, ई, m. (?) a sort of drum, = the next.
डमरु: डमरु, उस्, m. a musical instrument, a sort of small drum shaped like an hour-glass and held in one hand; anything surprising, any strange occurrence &c.
डमरुक: डमरुक, अम्, n. a kind of drum.
डम्प्: डम्प् डम्प्, cl. 10. A. डम्पयते, &c. (a various reading for डप्), to heap together.
डम्ब्: डम्ब् डम्ब्, cl. 10. P. डम्बयति, &c., to throw, cast, send; order.
डम्बर: डम्बर डम्बर, अस्, m., N. of one of the attendants of Skanda; an assemblage, collection, mass; (अस्, आ, अम्), famous, renowned.
डम्भ्: डम्भ् डम्भ्, cl. 10. A. डम्भयते, &c. (various reading for डप्), to collect.
डयन: डयन डयन। See rt. डी, p. 357, col. 1.
डयन, अम्, n. flying in the air, the flight of a bird; a car or litter carried upon men's shoulders, a palanquin, a Dūlī.
डलक: डलक डलक or डल्लक, अम्, n. a sling, a basket, a Dūlī carried on men's shoulders by means of a stick and ropes like the beam and strings of a balance, (presents of fruit, sweetmeats, &c., are usu-ally sent in this manner); (अस्), m., N. of a man.
डलन: डलन डलन or डल्लन, अस्, m., N. of a scholiast on the medical work of Su-śruta.
डवित्थ: डवित्थ डवित्थ, अस्, m., N. of a man; a wooden antelope (?); [cf. डित्थ।]
डहु: डहु डहु, उस्, or ऊ, ऊस्, m. the plant Arto-carpus Lacucha.
डाकिनी: डाकिनी डाकिनी, f. a kind of female imp or evil being attending Kālī and feeding on human flesh; N. of a place; [cf. शाकिनी।] —डाकिनी-त्व, अम्, n. the condition of a female demon.
डाङ्कृति: डाङ्कृति डान्-कृति, इस्, f. (fr. डाम्, imitative sound, and 1. कृति), a sound, the clang of a bell, ding-dong, &c.; [cf. टाङ्-कार।]
डाङ्गरी: डाङ्गरी डाङ्गरी, f. = डङ्गरी, q. v.
डामर: डामर डामर, अस्, m. affray, riot, conflict without weapons &c. [cf. डमर]; rout, uproar, the bustle and confusion of festivity or strife; any surprising thing, sight, or occurrence; a N. common to six Tantras, viz. the Yoga-ḍāmara, Śiva-ḍ°, Durgā-ḍ°, Sārasvata-ḍ°, Brahma-ḍ°, and Gandharva-ḍ°; N. of one of the attendants of Śiva; N. of a race or mixed caste; (अस्, आ, अम्), riotous; [cf. उड्-डामर।] —डामर-त्व, अम्, n. the state of one who excites awe.
डालिम: डालिम डालिम, अस्, m. = दाडिम, a pome-granate.
डाहल: डाहल डाहल, अस्, m., N. of a people and their country.
डाहुक: डाहुक डाहुक, अस्, m. a gallinule; [cf. दात्यूह।]
डिक्करी: डिक्करी डिक्करी, f. a young woman; (wrong form for दिक्करी।)
डिङ्गर: डिङ्गर डिङ्गर, अस्, m. a servant, a slave; a rogue, a cheat; a low or depraved man; a fat man; throwing, flinging; invective, insult (?).
डिडका: डिडका डिडका, f. perhaps a wrong form for डिम्भका।
डिडिम: डिडिम डिडिम or डिडिमाणक, a kind of bird; [cf. टिट्टिभ।]
डिण्डिक: डिण्डिक डिण्डिक, अस्, m., N. of a mouse whose story is told in the Mahā-bh. Udyoga-parva 5440.
डिण्डिम: डिण्डिम डिण्डिम, अस्, m. a musical instru-ment, a kind of small drum or tabor; a plant bearing a small fruit, Carissa Carandas. —डिण्डिमेश्वर-तीर्थ (°म-ईश्°), अम्, n., N. of a Tīrtha.
डिण्डिर: डिण्डिर डिण्डिर, अस्, m. cuttle-fish bone considered to be the foam of the sea; [cf. हिण्डिर and डिण्डीर।] —डिण्डिर-मोदक, अम्, n. garlic.
डिण्डिश: डिण्डिश डिण्डिश, अस्, m. = टिण्डिश = तिन्दिश।
डिण्डीर: डिण्डीर डिण्डीर, अस्, m. cuttle-fish bone held to be the foam of the sea; [cf. डिण्डिर।]
डित्थ: डित्थ डित्थ, अस्, m., N. of a man; a wooden elephant; a good-looking dark-coloured young man who is conversant with every branch of learning; [cf. डवित्थ।]
डिप्: डिप् डिप् or डिम्प् or डिम्भ्, cl. 10. A. डे-पयते or डिम्पयते or डिम्भयते, to collect, heap together; डिप्, cl. 4. 6. 10. P. डिप्यति, डिपति, डेपयति, to throw, cast, send or order; to direct; also डिम्ब्, cl. 10. A. डिम्बयते; [cf. rt. टिप्।]
डिम्: डिम् डिम् (a Sautra root or one not occur-ring in the Dhātu-pāṭha), to hurt, injure.
डिम: डिम डिम, अस्, m. a dramatic entertainment, dramatic exhibition of battle or siege, such as the Tripura-dāha, in which the destruction of the three cities of Tripura by Śiva is dramatised; a kind of mixed caste.
डिम्ब: डिम्ब डिम्ब, अस्, m. affray, riot, conflict without weapons, mutual defiance, petty and predatory war, &c. [cf. डमर]; sound or noise occasioned by terror; an egg; a chrysalis; the embryo in the first stage of its existence; a new-born child, any young animal; the bladder, the spleen, the lungs; the uterus; a globe or ball. —डिम्ब-युद्ध, अम्, n. or डिम्बाहव (°ब-आह्°), अस्, m. petty warfare, affray, skirmish, riot, &c.
डिम्बिका: डिम्बिका डिम्बिका, f. a libidinous woman; a bubble; a kind of water-fly; = शोणक, Calosanthes Indica.
डिम्भ्: डिम्भ् डिम्भ् or डिम्ब्। See rt. डिप् above.
डिम्भ: डिम्भ डिम्भ, अस्, m. a new-born child, any young animal; a fool, an idiot, a blockhead; (आ), f. an infant. —डिम्भ-चक्र, अम्, n. a mystical circle; a diagram for telling fortunes.
डिम्भक: डिम्भक, अस्, इका, m. f. a new-born child, young animal; (अस्), m., N. of a general of Jarā-sandha, younger brother of Haṃsa and son of Brahma-datta.
डी: डी डी, cl. 1. 4. A. डयते, डीयते, डिड्ये, डयिष्यते, अडयिष्ट, डयितुम्, to fly, pass through the air; to go: Caus. P. डाययति, -यितुम्, अडीडयत्: Desid. डिडयिषते: Intens. डेडीयते, डेडयीति or डेडेति।
डयमान: डयमान, अस्, आ, अम्, flying, passing through the air.
डीतर: डीतर, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. following one another quickly.
डीन: डीन, अस्, आ, अम्, flown, flying; (अम्), n. flying, the flight of a bird. —डीन-डीनक, अस्, m. flying reiteratedly. —डीनावडीन (°न-अव्°), अम्, n. flying up and down; flying badly.
डुडुभ: डुडुभ डुडुभ or डुडुम, अस्, m. or डुण्डु, उस्, f. or डुण्डुभ, अस्, m. a kind of snake (Am-phisbæna) or lizard.
डौण्डुभ: डौण्डुभ, अस्, ई, अम्, of or belonging to an Amphisbæna.
डौण्डुभ डौण्डुभ (scil. रूप), the form of an Amphisbæna. See under डुडुभ।
डुण्डुल: डुण्डुल डुण्डुल, अस्, m. a small owl.
डुन्दुक: डुन्दुक डुन्दुक, अस्, m. a gallinule, = डाहुक।
डुलि: डुलि डुलि, इस्, f. a small turtle, a female turtle, = दुलि, कमठी।
डुलिका: डुलिका डुलिका, f. a kind of wagtail.
डुली: डुली डुली, f. a kind of pot-herb, = चिल्ली।
डोडी: डोडी डोडी, f. a sort of shrub, = जीवन्ती, जीवनी, &c.; [cf. क्षुपडोड-मुष्टि।]
डोम: डोम डोम, अस्, m. a man of low caste, a Ḍom; [cf. डम, डोम्ब; cf. also the N. for the Gypsies, रोम्।]
डोम्ब: डोम्ब डोम्ब, अस्, m. a man of low caste obtaining a livelihood by singing and music &c.; N. of a man.
डोर: डोर डोर or डोरक, अम्, n. a fillet of thread or cord tied round the arm or wrist; the string for tying a packet or parcel.
डोरडी: डोरडी डोरडी, f. a kind of Solanum, = वृहती।
ड्वल्: ड्वल् ड्वल्, Caus. P. ड्वालयति, &c., to mix; [cf. rt. ट्वल्।]
